lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: My photo shoot moved onto the day I had reserved for tournament practice. Everyone thinks I should pick one dream.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Do you have to choose forever, or just work out tomorrow?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: That is the question I needed. I love both. I just need people to respect the time I set aside for each.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Would you help me test a shorter practice plan sometime? Only when we both agree on a time.

choices.label: Of course. Your time belongs to you.
choices.reply: Thank you. I can be serious about both without apologizing.

choices.label: I am booked, but your boundaries make sense.
choices.reply: No problem. I can make my own plan too.
